# Global Pulse Clock
> Real-time time synchronization across major global hubs with on-demand AI-enhanced weather and time insights.

Global Pulse Clock provides live, accurate world time tracking and weather forecasts focused on key international cities including Berlin, New York, and Manila.

## Core Features
- Live World Time: High-precision time synchronization across multiple global time zones.
- Integrated Weather: Real-time weather observations and short-term forecasts per hub.
- AI Insights: On-demand AI-generated summary reports and time zone context.
